name: Update Task
description: Updates a specific and existing task. [See the documentation](https://developers.asana.com/docs/update-a-task)

configurable_props.name: project
configurable_props.label: Project
configurable_props.description: List of projects. This field uses the project GID.

configurable_props.name: task_gid
configurable_props.label: Task GID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the task to update

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the task. This is generally a short sentence fragment that fits on a line in the UI for maximum readability. However, it can be longer.

configurable_props.name: assignee_section
configurable_props.label: Assignee Section
configurable_props.description: The assignee section is a subdivision of a project that groups tasks together in the assignee's "My Tasks" list.

configurable_props.name: completed
configurable_props.label: Completed
configurable_props.description: True if the task is currently marked complete, false if not.

configurable_props.name: due_at
configurable_props.label: Due At
configurable_props.description: The UTC date and time on which this task is due, or null if the task has no due time. This takes an ISO 8601 date string in UTC and should not be used together with due_on.

configurable_props.name: due_on
configurable_props.label: Due On
configurable_props.description: The localized date on which this task is due, or null if the task has no due date. This takes a date with YYYY-MM-DD format and should not be used together with due_at.

configurable_props.name: html_notes
configurable_props.label: HTML Notes
configurable_props.description: The notes of the text with formatting as HTML.

configurable_props.name: notes
configurable_props.label: Notes
configurable_props.description: Free-form textual information associated with the task (i.e. its description).

configurable_props.name: start_on
configurable_props.label: Start On
configurable_props.description: The day on which work begins for the task , or null if the task has no start date. This takes a date with YYYY-MM-DD format.

configurable_props.name: custom_fields
configurable_props.label: Custom Fields
